name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Rich Tonkotsu Pork Chashu Ramen (No Spicy Oil Mod)
whyItWorks: Simmered pork bone broth is rich in gelatin, collagen, and amino acids that support gut barrier integrity. Served over tender wheat ramen noodles and soft braised pork chashu.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Tonkotsu Ramen with soft-boiled egg and braised chashu pork; ask for no chili oil and hold raw scallions.
watchOuts: Avoid spicy chili oil and ask to hold raw green onions
